Consumers: `reviewCheck` (review_closeout.go, Required=false + ApprovalOrigin), `proportionalReviewVerification` (review_bundle.go; under adoption the legacy singleton inheritance and `unreviewed_milestones` are skipped), `getCloseoutState` (CloseRequired, receipt, terminal only with receipt, new diagnostics), `ReachedMilestones`/`RoadmapsReachedBy`/`roadmapReachedApartFrom` (roadmaps.go), `milestoneReachedObligations`, `ReviewPlan.CloseoutReview` (out of the digest), doctor (`CloseoutReviewsOwed`), setup and `pose adopt` (capability_catalog.go `closeoutReviewPolicyCatalogEntry`, `SetCloseoutReviewPolicy`; refs/transfer adopt/retire no longer lower schema 5).
